275022619.assessment: QLP sectors 12,65,103 show smooth slopes and broad variability. The sharp-looking sector103 changes occur at segment edges. At the covered original nominal phase, the short-window signed depth is negative (brightening), and the template fit hits its timing/duration bounds. The fresh custom aperture shows smooth variability and segment offsets without a repeat narrow eclipse. Independent Terra audit retains PLAUSIBLE: the available representative data fail to establish recurring eclipses, but sparse/compromised coverage does not tie the original search detection to a specific demonstrated artifact. This is not a secure eclipse identification.
275022619.source: Fresh 11x11 TESScut images and TIC 60-arcsec cones were obtained in two sectors. Signed candidate-phase difference images and fixed-coordinate target/capable-neighbour comparisons were attempted using the original search phase. Since no real repeating eclipse exists to localize, these candidate-only fits do not establish an eclipse host or an off-target EB. They are retained as failed candidate tests, not localization detections. Capability limits use the original claimed depth and ignore aperture throughput/bandpass uncertainty.
275022619.geometry: Gaia NSS orbit metadata were inspected, but no photometric eclipse ephemeris was established; an eclipse/conjunction geometry comparison is therefore inapplicable. Nearness of the original search alias to the Gaia period cannot establish eclipses.
275022619.limitations: Representative three QLP sectors and two independent custom-extraction sectors; no exhaustive all-sector search, calibrated PRF/noise model, physical fit or sensitivity upper limit. No secure eclipse identification or exclusion of all possible shallow eclipses follows. Repetition and eclipse morphology remain scientifically uncertain; no calibrated sensitivity or propagated ephemeris-error analysis was performed.
275022619.next_check: Obtain a well-covered predicted candidate event in a distinct reduction and establish a second coherent detached eclipse before claiming an eclipse period or host.
275022619.signal_class: smooth variability and/or segment systematics; no established eclipses
275022619.gaia_association: No photometric eclipse orbit established; Gaia spectroscopic binarity not refuted.
